headline: ExxonMobil Trending After Subsidiary Completes $2.1 Billion Debt Tender
summary: Exxon Mobil is trending Tuesday. Its subsidiary announced the results of its cash tender offers for Pioneer Natural Resources notes.

headline: Oil Crisis Worsens, Diesel Hits Record High: Here's How to Trade It
summary: Oil prices surged as Gulf attacks disrupted Saudi infrastructure, threatening supplies; Brent topped $107 and U.S. diesel hit record highs.
